step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features Amazon MSK at the center acting as a Kafka Data Highway. On the left, data enters from external data sources into an S3 Data Lake and an EC2 instance running Neo4j, both feeding into MSK. At the top, a Fargate microservice produces business events into MSK. Downstream, MSK distributes data to a Fargate task running an Elasticsearch sync connector that indexes into OpenSearch, as well as to an AWS Lambda function for notification handling, and an HTTP Sink connector updating an external Marketing CRM.
